data.description_suggestion: Retrieve the current status and NSFW verdict of a submitted video job. Returns job state (`queued`, `processing`, `done`, or `failed`) and the NSFW classification result once processing completes. Job access is restricted to the owner's API key; unauthorized access or invalid job ids return 404. Use this endpoint to poll for completion after submitting a video with POST /v1/videos.
